About

Unsold food, meet hungry students

A food rescue platform connecting unsold food with people who need affordable meals.

Designed for

Students, young professionals, hostel residents and conscious consumers.

Core idea

Reduce food waste by helping cafes, bakeries and restaurants sell surplus food at affordable prices through time-based rescue drops, mystery boxes and gamified rewards.

Introduction · the problem

Two problems that should solve each other

Every day, cafes, bakeries and restaurants throw away perfectly edible food due to:

  • Excess production
  • Unsold inventory
  • Closing-time leftovers
  • Short shelf life
  • Lack of redistribution systems

At the same time:

  • Students struggle with food affordability
  • Hostel residents depend on expensive food delivery
  • Young users seek budget-friendly options
  • Consumers are becoming more sustainability conscious

This creates a major disconnect between food waste and food accessibility.

Ideation

From a sad discount list to a game people want to play

We started by watching cafes and bakeries throw away unsold food at the end of each day while students hunted for affordable meals. The goal was to make rescuing food emotionally engaging and exciting, rather than guilt-driven.

Early idea directions

01

Discount-based food rescue

Simple discounted food listings from nearby cafes and bakeries.

ProblemFunctional but emotionally weak.
02

Sustainability tracking

Users could see food rescued, money saved and environmental impact.

ResultAdded emotional satisfaction.
03

Mystery rescue boxes

Surprise food bundles at lower prices.

ResultMade the experience playful and exciting.
04

Campus-based offers

Student-exclusive rescue drops near colleges and hostels.

ResultSolved affordability for a specific target audience.
05

Gamification

Adding rescue streaks, points, badges and rewards.

ResultEncouraged repeated engagement and habit formation.

Project overview

What is Crumbs?

A mobile app that lets users discover discounted surplus food from nearby cafes, bakeries and restaurants.

Instead of wasting edible food, businesses can

  • Upload rescue deals
  • Sell surprise / mystery boxes
  • Create campus-specific offers
  • Reduce wastage
  • Increase customer reach

Users benefit through

  • Affordable meals
  • Daily deals
  • Gamified rewards
  • Sustainability tracking
  • Rescue streaks and points

Target audience

Who rescues food?

Primary users

  • Students
  • Hostel students
  • College-going users
  • Budget-conscious consumers
  • Frequent snack buyers

Young professionals

  • Office workers
  • Working individuals living alone
  • Users looking for quick affordable meals

Sustainability-conscious users

  • Eco-conscious consumers
  • Minimal waste lifestyle followers
  • Ethical buyers

Secondary research

What the papers said

  • Users are highly price sensitive. Students prioritise affordability over brand loyalty.
  • Visual appeal affects food decisions. People are more likely to buy if food looks fresh and premium.
  • Users enjoy gamified experiences. Reward systems increase repeat engagement.
  • Time-limited deals create urgency. Countdown timers and scarcity improve conversions.
  • Sustainability messaging builds emotional attachment. Users feel positive when their actions reduce waste.

User personas & scenarios

Three people, three rescues

Scenario: Unlocking student offers

Arjun Menon recently moved to a new city for his postgraduate studies and often looks for affordable food while managing hostel expenses. Exploring Crumbs, he discovers Campus Mode with student-exclusive rescue deals and verifies his account with his college email ID. Later he orders a discounted sandwich and pastry combo from a nearby cafe, earning rescue points, student badges and progress toward his rescue streak.
Campus-only bakery dropsExtra student discountsGroup combo offersMidnight rescue deals

Scenario: Late evening rescue drop

Aanya finishes college classes at 7:30 PM and opens Crumbs on the way back to her hostel. The app shows a nearby bakery rescue drop: 60% off pastries, only 3 boxes left. She quickly reserves one, and while picking up the order she earns rescue points, a streak reward and progress toward a free mystery box.
ExcitingAffordableRewardingSustainable

Scenario: Listing rescue drops

At the end of the day Neha notices several fresh pastries and sandwiches still unsold in her bakery. Instead of wasting them, she opens Crumbs with her Business Login and uploads real-time images, quantity, discounted prices and pickup timing. Within minutes nearby users discover the drop, and she starts receiving orders in real time.
Real-time product imagesQuantity availableDiscounted pricesPickup timing
